KXCANADACUP.sample_title: Will a Canadian team win the Stanley Cup® by the end of the 2030 season?
KXCANADACUP.rules_sample: If a Canadian hockey team wins the Stanley Cup® after Issuance and before Jun 30, 2030, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL.sample_title: Will Washington Capitals win the 2026-27 Stanley Cup® Finals?
KXNHL.rules_sample: If Washington Capitals wins the 2026-27 Stanley Cup® Finals, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL1P.rules_sample: If neither team wins the 1st period of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL1PSPREAD.sample_title: San Jose wins 1st Period by over 1.5 goals
KXNHL1PSPREAD.rules_sample: If San Jose wins by more than 1.5 goals in the 1st period of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL1PTOTAL.rules_sample: If the teams collectively score more than 2.5 goals in the 1st Period of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL2P.rules_sample: If neither team wins the 2nd period of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL2PSPREAD.sample_title: San Jose wins 2nd Period by over 1.5 goals
KXNHL2PSPREAD.rules_sample: If San Jose wins by more than 1.5 goals in the 2nd period of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL2PTOTAL.rules_sample: If the teams collectively score more than 4.5 goals in the 2nd Period of the Edmonton vs New York R NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL3P.rules_sample: If neither team wins the 3rd period (excluding overtime) of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL3PSPREAD.sample_title: San Jose wins 3rd Period by over 1.5 goals
KXNHL3PSPREAD.rules_sample: If San Jose wins by more than 1.5 goals in the 3rd period (excluding overtime) of the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHL3PTOTAL.rules_sample: If the teams collectively score more than 4.5 goals in the 3rd Period of the Edmonton vs New York R NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLADAMS.sample_title: Jack Adams Award: Todd McLellan wins
KXNHLADAMS.rules_sample: If Todd McLellan wins the NHL Jack Adams Award in the 2026-27 NHL season, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLAST.rules_sample: If Tim Stutzle records 2+ assists in the Ottawa vs Anaheim NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLATLANTIC.sample_title: Will the Toronto Maple Leafs win the Atlantic Division?
KXNHLATLANTIC.rules_sample: If the Toronto Maple Leafs win the 2026-27 NHL Atlantic Division, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLCALDER.sample_title: Calder Memorial Trophy: Zeev Buium wins
KXNHLCALDER.rules_sample: If Zeev Buium wins the NHL Calder Memorial Trophy in the 2026-27 NHL season, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLCENTRAL.sample_title: Will the Winnipeg Jets win the Central Division?

KXNHLEAST.sample_title: Will the Washington Capitals win the Eastern Conference Finals?
KXNHLEAST.rules_sample: If the Washington Capitals win the 2026-27 NHL Eastern Conference Finals, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLEXPANSION.sample_title: Will Houston receive an NHL expansion team before 2027?
KXNHLEXPANSION.rules_sample: If the NHL officially announces the award of an expansion team franchise to Houston before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLF10G.sample_title: Either team to score in the first 10 minutes
KXNHLF10G.rules_sample: If at least 1 goal is scored by either Calgary or San Jose during the first 10 minutes of the first period (from 0:00 elapsed up to, but not including, 10:00 elapsed) in the Calgary vs San Jose NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

KXNHLGOAL.rules_sample: If Scott Morrow records 1+ goals in the Edmonton vs New York R NHL game originally scheduled for Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
